versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 adds an enhanced facial skin-analysis workflow.

- Supports skin-pro default scoring and 察颜 scoring.
- Reports skin score, skin age, skin type and tone, plus severity and counts for skin concerns.
- Adds photo-quality checks, result interpretation guidance, and optional face ID detection with user authorization.
- Includes reminders that results are informational and do not replace medical evaluation.
